findings.title: Preserve or migrate the public `findMany` API
findings.body: This change removes the service’s public `findMany` method and replaces it with a condition builder, but no production call sites are migrated in this PR. Any existing caller of `InsightsBookingService.findMany(...)` will no longer type-check, so the application cannot build until those callers are updated or a compatible method is retained.

findings.title: Execute org and team authorization SQL in integration tests
findings.body: The only database-backed query here uses user scope, which does not exercise the new `ANY(...)` array predicates. The org/team tests only compare `Prisma.Sql` fragments, so they will not catch invalid PostgreSQL array binding or incorrect authorization results when those predicates execute. Add database-backed queries covering org and team scopes.
